breakdown.description: Saturation temperature is inconsistent with the stated condenser pressure (10 kPa does not correspond to 100 C).
breakdown.reason: The Agent correctly identified the physical inconsistency between the stated pressure (10 kPa) and saturation temperature (100 C). It resolved this by prioritizing the given pressure and providing the correct corresponding saturation temperature (approx. 45.8 °C), which is the same correction made in the ground truth.
